name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio: Rhys' journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing himself, but through a fascination with the engineering that underpins it. After completing his apprenticeship in aerospace engineering, Rhys transitioned into motorsport, drawn by the dynamic and demanding nature of composite technology. He quickly established himself as a reliable and adaptable technician, working on everything from chassis repairs to aerodynamic upgrades. His approach is methodical and precise, ensuring the highest quality standards are met. Rhys is particularly adept at finding innovative solutions to complex problems, often utilizing his knowledge of materials science to improve performance and durability. He has been described as a 'composite whisperer' by his colleagues.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height and build, with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always has a perfectly sharpened pencil behind his ear.
Can identify the type of carbon fiber weave by touch alone.
Insists on using traditional hand tools whenever possible, even when power tools would be faster.
